visual_action: A montage of quick, successive close-up shots of different actors from various films. The actors all display expressions of concern, shock, or dismay. This includes Al Pacino, Robert Downey Jr., Jake Gyllenhaal, Richard Gere, Tom Holland, Sadie Sink, Dylan O'Brien, and Bruce Willis.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The on-screen text reads, "Americans watching as Democrats refuse to stand in support of protecting Americans not illegals." The caption also states, "Its pretty clear who Democrats are fighting for."

on_screen_text.text: Americans watching as Democrats refuse to stand in support of protecting Americans not illegals.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of the song "She Knows" by J. Cole, featuring vocal samples.
audio_music: The song "She Knows" by J. Cole plays throughout the video. The track has a serious, dramatic, and somber tone, which amplifies the concerned expressions shown on screen.

central_claim: The Democratic Party deliberately chooses to protect undocumented immigrants at the expense of American citizens.
intended_effect: To make the viewer feel that the Democratic Party has abandoned American citizens, thereby generating disapproval of and anger towards Democrats.
